company_name: Zhejiang Dongkai Semiconductor Science&Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company provides essential systems for semiconductor equipment manufacturing and process systems, including gas supply and treatment solutions.
summary: Zhejiang Dongkai Semiconductor Science & Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in comprehensive solutions for semiconductor equipment manufacturing, focusing on centralized supply systems for electronic specialty gases and wet electronic chemicals. The company is committed to innovation and quality, aiming to support the localization of China's semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Centralized supply systems for electronic specialty gases
Exhaust gas recovery and treatment systems
GC Gas Holder for safe storage and distribution of specialty gases

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, the company is actively involved in the local semiconductor market.
